definition: a measured portion of medicine taken at one time
description: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

de.answer: Sie misst eine Dosis Öl ab.
